headline: CME Group (CME) to Launch Ether Futures to Boost Crypto Trading
summary:
CME Group Inc. CME is set to introduce a futures contract on ether, the world’s second-largest cryptocurrency by market value in February 2021, subject to regulatory approval.

The new contract will be cash-settled. Ether is based on formidable blockchain technology and the CME CF Ether-Dollar rates will provide a standardized reference rate and spot price index to bring confidence to any trading strategy.
